entries.msgstr: Start a Random Battle in a vehicle of any tier.
Welcome to the game! Battle with other fans from all across the world, and celebrate spectacular victories!
First Battle
Research and purchase any Tier IV vehicle.
Purchasing a new vehicle is an important occasion. With each new tier, the vehicles get more interesting. A trained crew will also improve overall gameplay.
Tier IV Vehicle
Fight three Random Battles in Tier IV–X vehicles with any applied customization element.
You can customize vehicles by changing their exterior with preset styles or by creating your own style using camouflage, inscriptions, emblems, and decals.
Vehicle Exteriors
Start training any perk for any crew member.
Crew members can train additional perks to enhance their effectiveness or obtain new capabilities.
Crew Perks
Earn 150,000 credits in Random Battles in Tier IV–X vehicles.
The higher the battle level, the more credits you will need to maintain your vehicle, replenish ammunition, and purchase modules and equipment.
Accumulating Credits
Research and purchase any Tier V vehicle.
Tier V is where the more serious vehicles start appearing and where your game skills are truly put to the test. A completely trained crew will really come in handy.
Tier V Vehicle
Fight 10 Random Battles in Tier V–X vehicles with three equipment items mounted.
Coated Optics or Improved Ventilation? The right equipment can boost your vehicle's strengths and reduce its weaknesses.
Mounting Equipment
Complete one basic scenario in the Topography mode.
To gain confidence on the battlefield, it is best to have a good understanding of pathways, tactics, and maps, including the key positions and objects on them.
Topography
Complete four advanced scenarios on one map in Topography.
Enter the Topography mode from time to time to study maps for Random Battles. The four scenarios allow you to explore the location from different angles.
Advanced Topography
Fight 10 Random Battles in Tier V-X vehicles with an activated Personal Reserve.
When activated, you can get additional bonuses to Combat XP, Free and Crew XP, or credits after each battle.
Personal Reserves
Be among the top 10 players on your team by XP earned six times in victorious Random Battles in Tier V-X vehicles.
These missions allow you to earn five times more XP per successful battle. For this, you need to win and be among the top 10 players on your team by XP earned.
6 Missions for ×5 XP
Research a module and mount it on a vehicle of any tier.
Combat XP is awarded after each battle. Earn Combat XP to research new modules that improve your vehicle's efficiency.
Combat XP
Research and purchase any Tier VI vehicle.
In each subsequent tier, researching vehicles will require more time and effort. Free XP will help you advance faster, and a trained crew will come in handy.
Tier VI Vehicle
Complete one Personal Mission in any campaign.
Campaigns are chains of missions for different types of vehicles. When completed, you can obtain useful rewards and unique vehicles.
Personal Missions
Train a crew with a Universal Manual.
Crew Books allow you to significantly accelerate crew training by adding a certain amount of XP to one or all crew members.
Crew Books
Fight 10 Random Battles in Tier VI-X vehicles equipped with a crew directive.
Directives can improve crew perks for one battle. Like consumables, directives can be purchased or received as a reward.
Directives for Crew
Purchase a special Rookie Bundle in the in-game Store.
You can purchase everything you need in the in-game Store, including gold, Premium vehicles, and more. You will find regular promotions that offer great deals.
Store
Fight 10 Random Battles in Tier VI-X Premium vehicles.
These vehicles do not need to be researched. They earn more Combat XP, Crew XP, and credits, and they allow you to transfer a crew without retraining.
Premium Vehicles
Fight 10 Random Battles in Tier VI-X vehicles with a directive for equipment.
Directives allow you to increase the effectiveness of mounted equipment. Like consumables, directives can be purchased or received as a reward.
Directives for Equipment
Be in the top 10 players on your team by XP earned 15 times in Random Battles in Tier VI-X vehicles.
These missions allow you to earn five times more XP per successful battle. For this, you need to win and be among the top 10 players on your team by XP earned.
15 Missions for ×5 XP
Research and purchase any Tier VII vehicle.
For this vehicle tier, the skill requirements increase even more. Vehicles become more formidable and more efficient—just like your opponents.
Tier VII Vehicle
Fight 10 Random Battles in Tier VII-X vehicles equipped with a Large First Aid Kit, Large Repair Kit, and Automatic Fire Extinguisher.
When equipped, large consumables repair damaged modules faster than small ones. They also reduce stun duration and the chance of fire, and have a shorter cooldown time.
Large Consumables
Receive double the XP for your first victory of the day in Random Battles in a vehicle of any tier.
You can receive twice the XP for your first victory of the day in each vehicle. Use this feature to upgrade your vehicles even faster.
XP Multiplier
Create a blueprint fragment for any unresearched vehicle.
Blueprints provide a discount in XP and speed up research on a vehicle. They can be received as a reward or converted from universal and national fragments.
Vehicle Blueprints
Be in the top 10 players on your team by XP earned 20 times in Random Battles in Tier VII-X vehicles.
These missions allow you to earn five times more XP per successful battle. For this, you need to win and be among the top 10 players on your team by XP earned.
20 Missions for ×5 XP
Research and purchase any Tier VIII vehicle.
Tier VIII vehicles require you to use all your gained knowledge. Enemies will not let you get bored, providing high-octane thrills and invaluable experience.
Tier VIII Vehicle
Use Free XP to research any module.
If you do not have enough Combat XP to research a module or vehicle, you can use Free XP, which can be earned for any vehicle.
Free XP
Load some alternative shells and start a Random Battle in a Tier III–X vehicle.
Armor-Piercing, High-Explosive, and Armor-Piercing Composite Rigid shells are used for different situations in battle. Choose wisely to gain an advantage!
Ammunition
Sell an unused module from the Depot.
Unused modules, shells, equipment, consumables, and other items are stored in the Depot. You can sell extra items for credits.
Depot
Earn 25,000 credits in Random Battles in Tier III-X vehicles.
Credits are used to purchase shells and new vehicles, repair vehicles, and more. It is important to know how to save up and use them wisely.
Credits
Fight three Random Battles in Tier III–X vehicles with consumables mounted in all available slots.
Consumables can fix critical vehicle damage and heal crew injuries in battle. Using consumables at the right time is crucial for surviving on the battlefield.
Consumables
Fight three Random Battles in Tier III–X vehicles with any mounted equipment.
Vehicles can be outfitted with equipment in order to improve some of their characteristics. The equipment loadout will depend on the vehicle and playstyle.
Equipment
Topography
Complete one scenario on any map in Topography
Terra Incognita
Complete four basic scenarios on one map in Topography
Reconnaissance
Complete four advanced scenarios on one map in Topography
An A in Geography
